name: Rickman Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single primary residence with a gray shingle roof set back from a two-lane public road|A paved driveway leads from the street to the house|A detached structure with a light-colored roof sits beside the house|Lawn and planted areas occupy the yard|Mature trees line the road and wrap much of the lot|Open grass and wooded ground extend behind the developed area.

alpha.desc: The front of the property faces James Way SE with a two-lane road, a paved driveway, and dense mature trees screening the house from the street|The residence sits behind the tree line|A second drive or lane is visible to one side of the trees|Open grass occupies the front setback.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property shows the residence, the detached light-roof structure, rear lawn, and a small water feature in the yard|Mature trees frame both sides of the developed area|Open grass and wooded ground extend behind the house|The public road remains visible at the front.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the back of the residence, rear lawn, and dense mature trees wrapping the lot|The detached structure is visible beside the house|Wooded ground and open grass continue beyond the yard|Sightlines from the rear are limited by the tree cover.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows a paved lane or drive running along the edge of the property towards the detached light-roof structure, and dense mature trees along the road|Open grass and wooded ground occupy the remainder of this side|The main house sits behind the tree line|The public road runs along the frontage.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from James Way SE to the house, with a second lane visible along one side of the lot. The site is a rural residence set behind dense mature trees. The front tree line limits sightlines from the road. Open grass around the house and detached structure provides some movement space. Neighboring rural lots, fields, and additional outbuildings occupy the surrounding area.
